content.comment_body: Is it possible to power a [product_name] using a 12VDC battery while keeping an automatic battery charger permanently connected?

analysis.insight_summary: A user asks if a particular [product_name] can run on a 12V DC battery when an automatic battery charger is always connected. Users are mainly looking for assurance about safe and approved powering methods for their [product_name], especially in combined battery and charger configurations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] to work safely and reliably with a 12VDC battery, even if the automatic charger remains connected at all times.
